source_snapshot.procedure: Use LTSSM tooling for 500 Gen2-to-Gen3 speed changes.
source_snapshot.criteria: Train to expected width and Gen3 speed with no errors.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 30 attended and 180 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes NVIDIA tooling but does not prove the defining Gen2 start or each atomic transition.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending for Speed Change 23 recipe, path, Gen2 start, 500 results and recovery.

old_problem: Without a pinned Speed Change 23 operation, path identity and per-cycle Gen2/full-width start proof, a tool could remain at Gen3 and report a successful target without exercising the required transition. Final-state evidence also loses intermediate failures.
disposition_reason: The source fixes direction, count and outcome: 500 Gen2-to-Gen3 transitions at expected width with no errors. Exact vendor action, topology, start enforcement, timing and error deltas can be runtime Project Configuration. Pending is removed, while every iteration must independently prove Gen2 entry before Gen3 request and a first-fault interlock prevents retries from masking sequence failure.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2106, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2107 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00028-V002 / 078dd58b6195cdf5 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Speed Change 23 is uniquely Gen2-to-Gen3 and cannot inherit Gen1-to-Gen3 or following Gen2-to-Gen4 results.
Bind the owner-pinned LTSSM/NVQual action and root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/lane topology before transitions.
Each cycle proves a full-width Gen2 starting state, then records Gen3 request, LTSSM path, settle deadline, final Gen3/full width, enumeration and fresh error/health deltas.
A cycle lacking Gen2 start or complete artifacts is invalid and cannot be silently replayed; all 500 chronological transactions remain visible.
Stop before the next request on wrong start, late/failed Gen3, width loss, endpoint/sibling loss, new disqualifying AER, reset, log gap or safety anomaly.
Preserve baseline and first-fault evidence, use only signed recovery and never clear or auto-retry.
No LTSSM/NVQual, Gen2/Gen3 speed change, retraining, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Prove the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe path completes five hundred genuine full-width Gen2-to-Gen3 transitions within the signed deadline without disqualifying link or platform errors.
required_package: Pinned approved NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 23 build, command and configuration
Approved method proving Gen2/full-width start before every transaction
Gen3 request, LTSSM/settle/transient/error acceptance and exact 500-count rules
Dedicated SUT, durable ledger/interlock, stable power/cooling, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve topology/link/error/health baselines; after point approval execute only Speed Change 23 for ledger entries 1..500. Before every request record and validate Gen2/full-width entry; then capture Gen3 request, LTSSM trajectory, settled speed/width, enumeration, error deltas and health before enabling the next cycle. Stop at first invalid start, failure or evidence gap; do not clear or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 500 entries contain an independently proven Gen2/full-width start and settle to Gen3 at required width within deadline, with endpoint/siblings present, no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error, and approved final health.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until recipe, topology, start method and acceptance limits are approved. Then PASS requires 500 complete accepted Gen2-to-Gen3 records. FAIL on wrong/missing start, late/wrong/reduced target, endpoint loss, disqualifying error/reset or recovery failure. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; replay cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until tool/path, Gen2-start proof, Gen3 target, error/deadline policy, interlock and recovery are approved.
Use an isolated SUT with console, stable power/cooling and immediate point authorization.
Durably preserve every starting/transition/final state and all error evidence.
Stop without retry on first invalid start, transition/link/device/error/evidence or safety anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, Speed Change 23 tool/configuration and approval
Path/lane map plus Gen2-start and Gen3/full-width/LTSSM/deadline/error contract
Ledger 1..500 with raw Gen2 start, request, LTSSM, settled Gen3/width, enumeration, timestamps and result
Per-cycle error/platform-health correlation and completeness/gap audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final topology/health, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On invalid Gen2 entry, failed/late/downtrained Gen3, endpoint or sibling loss, disqualifying error/reset or gap, inhibit later requests and preserve that record. Do not substitute adjacent speed-change coverage or retry; use signed recovery and quarantine if expected topology/health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: Source consistently defines Gen2-to-Gen3 500 times; missing start enforcement/tool/limits are parameterizable project inputs.

blocked.reason: Review method is complete; runtime execution remains conditional on approved proprietary artifacts and bindings.
